title: fix(skills): objectstack-platform — a seeded `sys_user` row lands as an account-less directory row, it is not refused (#26302 follow-up)

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ81ut4uJxWyaaick9b2LrTc1)_
Fixes #26302
Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:把 PR #26420 刚合并进 objectstack-platform 技能包的那一小节里写错的一句改对:种子里写的 `sys_user` 行不是「被拒(ADR-0092)」,而是落成一条没有账号、谁也登不进的目录行;eval 7 的括号同改。两行天花板按实测重钉(5981→5997、1458→1469,headroom 0),注释写成相对 main 的增量。
- **为什么改**:席位对 #26420 的合同复核(PR 评论 6433051864)判 FAIL 就在这一句——种子写入走系统上下文,绕过 ADR-0092 的身份写保护,运行时测试钉住了这行会落库;队列在复核贴出前已把 #26420 合进 main,所以这是同一张卡的补丁轮。
- **风险与回滚**:只改一句教学、一处 eval 措辞和两行天花板数字;不发版、无运行时改动,回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 第 445–447 行那一句;② `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 两行(5997 / 1469)及其增量注释;③ eval 7 的 `expected_output`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` —— 全绿,objectstack-platform 的 SKILL.md 与 eval 文件 headroom 都是 0。
- **需要你做的**:Approve(Tier H,`skills/**` 是发布面)或「Merge when ready」。

## What changes

The patch round the contract review of PR #26420 ordered (PR comment 6433051864, VERDICT FAIL, ①(a) item 1). That PR landed on `main` as `75afeffd` with the sentence in it, so this is a follow-up on the same card:

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` — the opening reason of *Demo accounts — `demoStaff` vs `devLogins`* now says what the platform does: "a `sys_user` row written through `data` lands as a directory row with no account, so nobody can sign in as it". The former "is refused (ADR-0092)" was copied from the `demo-staff.zod.ts` TSDoc and is false against the runtime: seed inserts run under `SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT` (`isSystem: true`), the ADR-0092 identity write guard bypasses system-context writes (`identity-write-guard.ts` `isUserContextWrite`, pinned by its test), and `app-plugin.seed.test.ts` pins a `data: [{ object: 'sys_user' }]` row being inserted; `dev-admin-seed-gate.ts` measured the result as "a directory row with no account". The ADR citation is dropped.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` — eval 7's expected output says "(it lands as a directory row nobody can sign in as)" instead of "(refused)". Assertions unchanged.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — the two `objectstack-platform` rows re-pinned at the new measurement, each with a delta comment under the record that landed in #26420.

The spec prose that misled the section (`demo-staff.zod.ts` lines 14–16, and the `dev-login.zod.ts` guidance that tells an author to seed the user in `data`) is card #26424, filed by the seat; not touched here.

## Why

A published teaching that states a refusal the platform does not perform sends an AI author to expect a load-time failure where the row silently lands dead — the worse outcome, and exactly the "who pays" card #26302 names.

### Line budget (`skills/**` is a published surface)

Whole-file, before → after, lines (before = `main` at `75afeffd`):

| File | Before | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 503 | 504 |
| `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` | 75 | 75 |

Whole-package (`SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`): **2107 → 2108** (+1; the seven other `.md` files are untouched; `references/_index.md` generator-owned, 41).

### Token ratchet — maintainer ruling A, delta from `main`

Same ruling as #26420 (the maintainer's tap on the seat thread's decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」, 2026-10-27T01:21Z, verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」). Nothing duplicated was added, so there is nothing to cut; the remainder is the rewording itself:

| Row | `main` | Added | After | Ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `SKILL.md` (priced text, minus the 20-byte stamp line) | 23924 B = 5981 tok | +61 B | 23985 B = 5997 tok | 5981 → **5997** (+16) |
| `evals/config-plugins-ops.json` | 5831 B = 1458 tok | +42 B | 5873 B = 1469 tok | 1458 → **1469** (+11) |

Both rows pinned AT the measurement (headroom 0). No other row is touched; the diff against `main` is these three files only.

## Tests

No TypeScript changed; the reworded sentence is prose. The six-shape `defineStack` probe from #26420 still describes the schema (unchanged); the reworded reason is read off `identity-write-guard.ts`, `execution-context.zod.ts`, `app-plugin.seed.test.ts` and `dev-admin-seed-gate.ts` as above. Dogfood battery: n/a — no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Acceptance notes

- `Fixes #26302` because the seat reopened the card for this patch round; the rest of #26420's review passed and is not re-done here.
- Branch restarted from `main` at `75afeffd` (GitHub deleted the merged head branch), so the history is `main` + two commits; no force-push.
- Commit author on both commits is the clone's configured identity.
